text:
ashwin: Sharing the PRD draft for embedding harmonization and migration safety net. Link: https://redwood.infra/notes/embedding-harmonization-draft — please focus on acceptance criteria and launch gating.

elena: Thanks — will review. can you summarize the hard launch blockers we should call out in the PRD?

ashwin: high level: 1) backward compatibility strategy for dim changes (padding/trunc) 2) normalization behavior guarantees (server toggle + SDK flags) 3) batch semantics (ordering, deterministic padding) 4) regression thresholds on rerank metrics (p@10 drift <= 2%) 5) rollout plan + canary + rollback.

sam: for dim changes — is the plan to expose a compatibility mode in the API, or handle transparently server-side? customers will complain if SDKs need changes.

ashwin: aim for transparent server-side compat for 90% cases: if old dims -> right-pad with zeros and include `embed_version` header. SDK will get a small opt-in helper to surface warnings. explicit opt-in only for clients wanting strict checking.

tara: FYI BigCorp asked for "no silent truncation" and strict version pinning. we should add an acceptance criterion: any automatic padding/truncation must generate a deprecation warning and a trace entry with request id.

ashwin: agreed. add to PRD: "no silent truncation; deprecation warnings + trace entries." owner: @ashwin.

elena: on normalization: customers expect cosine-equivalent embeddings. proposal: default server-side normalize=true for hosted, but provide `normalize=false` toggle for private deployments. add acceptance test that L2 norm after normalize ~1 within epsilon 1e-3.

ashwin: adding acceptance criteria: "Normalized outputs must have L2 norm within 0.001 of 1.0". Also record: we must provide SDK helper `normalize_embeddings()` and document difference.

sam: batch semantics: need to ensure deterministic padding across batch boundaries so batching doesn't change embedding values. can you add a simple config patch we can ship?

ashwin: pasted sample config for runtime batching — can we validate this as part of the acceptance tests?

```
# runtime batching config
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  pad_to_multiple_of: 8   # ensure consistent internal tensor shapes
  deterministic_padding: true
  per_request_metadata: ["embed_version", "client_sdk_version"]
```

tara: that looks good. add a test: run same requests split across batches vs single batch -> embeddings difference < 1e-4 (L2).

elena: launch gating proposal: docs + SDK patch, automated compatibility test suite green, canary at 5% traffic for 48h with rollback signal on p@10 drift > 1.5% or error spike > 2x. legal/compliance sign-off for Private.

ashwin: noted. acceptance checklist items assigned: docs (elena), SDK helper (sam), runtime changes + tests (ashwin), customer comms + BigCorp coordination (tara).

deploy-bot: Document updated: embedding-harmonization-draft.md (rev 4) by ashwin.

elena: thanks all — i'll fold these into the PRD and circulate v0.2 for final review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam: one more ask — include a quick migration script example for customers to convert old vectors to new dims (padding + re-normalize). small snippet in docs will help adoption.

ashwin: will add snippet and a small eval harness to run on customer data. closing this thread for now, continuing in PRD comments.
